channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Minnesota’s most expensive house listing just dropped in price
item.description: The Wayzata estate on Lake Minnetonka was quietly shopped in 2024 for $68 million and officially listed last year at $55 million before this latest re-marketing.

item.title: Most Team USA players who skipped events in Washington say they wanted to get home
item.description: Many team members went to the White House and State of the Union address, but five headed straight to their NHL teams after landing in Miami on Monday.

item.title: 5 new restaurants to know about — and what you should order
item.description: Across the metro you’ll find sleek cocktail dens, serious sandwiches and sweet reasons to get out of bed a little earlier in the mornings.

item.title: Edina, Moorhead boys hockey win section titles to earn return trip to 2A state tourney
item.description: St. Cloud Cathedral and Hibbing/Chisholm win sections in Class 1A, with Hibbing beating Cloquet/Esko/Carlton in overtime.

item.title: Man charged with threatening to kill Minnesota senator, inflict violence at State Capitol
item.description: Charges say he threated to kill lawmakers over losing money during the COVID-19 shutdown.

item.title: Maple Grove girls basketball coach Mark Cook placed on leave
item.description: Cook, last season’s Class 4A coach of the year, has coached at Maple Grove for 21 seasons.

item.title: Trump repeats claim of $19 billion in Minnesota fraud. Here’s what the numbers show.
item.description: State officials say the statistic Trump included in his State of Union address is incorrect and a “political” number.

item.title: St. Paul church congregant sues ICE protesters, journalists who disrupted January worship service
item.description: The complaint names Nekima Levy Armstrong and journalists Don Lemon and Georgia Fort.

item.title: Ilhan Omar’s State of the Union guest arrested by U.S. Capitol Police during Trump’s speech
item.description: Minneapolis resident Aliya Rahman was removed from the House chamber after she stood up silently during a portion of the address.

item.title: White House to pause $259M in Minnesota Medicaid dollars in fraud crackdown
item.description: It’s the latest in a growing list of fraud-focused threats and probes from the Trump administration.
